messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Nothing to do with Lyra — can you chase Denham Lewis for the outstanding signature pages on the Caspian commercial contract? The client wants it wrapped before the quarter-end. Thanks.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
